scripts.cache::migrate::sqlite: bun run cache/drizzle/migrator_pre.ts && bunx drizzle-kit generate --config=cache/drizzle/sqlite.ts && bunx drizzle-kit --config=cache/drizzle/sqlite.ts push && rm .env
scripts.cache::migrate::postgres: bun run cache/drizzle/migrator_pre.ts && bunx drizzle-kit generate --config=cache/drizzle/postgres.ts && bunx drizzle-kit --config=cache/drizzle/postgres.ts push --verbose && rm .env
scripts.cache::prod: bun cache::migrate && cd cache && bun run index.ts
scripts.test::merge_coverage: bunx lcov-result-merger 'coverage/*_lcov.info' coverage/lcov.info && genhtml coverage/lcov.info -o coverage/html && lcov --list coverage/lcov.info && rm coverage/.lcov.info.*.tmp
scripts.test::all: bun test::cache::ci && bun test::shared::ci && bun test::merge_coverage && lcov --list coverage/lcov.info
